reader.notes: Alternate keys register in declaration order with their windows and DUPLICATES flag; each becomes its own B+ tree in the store. At --std 2023 the same program gives R2=00, the expected edition difference.

refuter.evidence: Probe rc_multi.cob: the alternate key was declared only in REC-B and the record was written through REC-A. The key was maintained, READ KEY IS IX-ALT found it, and REWRITE through REC-B created a duplicate, 02 (OK §1985:IX.2.5.4 GR4 'implicitly referenced in keys for all other record description entries'). Class c compile-only probes (rf_*.cob): SUPPRESS WHEN gave COBOL0900 'requires COBOL-2023', SOURCE IS gave COBOL0900 'requires COBOL-2002', a PIC 9 alternate key gave COBOL0863 (OK §1985:IX.2.5.3 SR2 'must be defined as a data item of the category alphanumeric'), an alternate key at the prime key's leftmost position gave COBOL0863, and ALTERNATE KEY with no RECORD gave COBOL5506.
